data.narrative:
Armada is a Series B-stage Space & Aerospace company founded by Dan Wright and Jon Runyan that has raised $186M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comp universe of 5 public traded aerospace firms (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) and 8 private peers in the same sector and stage window, including Sierra Space, Cowboy Space Corporation, Varda Space Industries, Aalyria, and Skyryse.

Two valuation methods apply to Armada. Stage-progression analysis uses the $186M total raised as a proxy base and applies a 1.9x step-up multiplier typical of Series B advancement, yielding $353M. Peer-median triangulation across the five same-sector comparable companies produces a $1.5B median valuation, with a range spanning $1.1B to $8.0B. Public-comp anchoring using the Space & Aerospace sector P/S median of 23.9x cannot be applied absent disclosed revenue data. Public comps trade at material multiples, but this method remains inapplicable for a private target.

The two applicable methods produce a triangulated range of $300M (low) to $1.7B (high), with a median of $927M. The wide spread reflects material stage and revenue-scale heterogeneity within the peer set, particularly the $8.0B outlier (Sierra Space). Key uncertainties include Armada's revenue trajectory and competitive position relative to larger peers. The peer-median estimate likely carries greater weight given stage alignment; stage-progression may understate value if Armada commands premium multiples within its cohort.
